name: cli-post-edit-digest
description: M22 CX (Wave-1 coding X-rider) acceptance fixture for the C1 post-edit verify hook: a write_file mutation of a .ts file triggers the automatic post-edit typecheck, and the resulting diagnostics digest is fed back to the model in the write_file tool_result next turn. The typechecker is stubbed by a deterministic fake `tsc` shim placed on PATH via a subprocess re-exec (forbid(unsafe_code) blocks std::env::set_var), so the hook fires with no real toolchain in CI; the emitted digest is byte-identical to fixtures/diagnostics/post-edit-digest/recorded-digest.json. Scripted mock provider: write a BROKEN index.ts (turn 1), then a closing acknowledgement (turn 2) whose provider request body carries the fed-back digest. Registered in tests/replay.rs via the same re-exec seam the verify-gate fixtures use. See README.md.
